annotations.title: Recommend an MCP stack for a workflow

description: For a multi-step workflow, recommend the smallest set of MCP servers that covers every detected capability, each one's role, and the order (read inputs, process, write outputs). Extra MCPs are never added for padding, and any capability left uncovered is reported. Example: 'monitor GitHub pull requests and notify the team on Slack'.

deployment_preference.description: Prefer hosted (remote) or on-machine (local) servers; soft preference

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

open_source_preference.description: Prefer open-source servers (soft preference, not a hard filter)

platform.description: Target client, e.g. claude-code, cursor, vscode

task.description: The workflow to accomplish, naming services and actions

name: recommend_stack
title: Recommend an MCP stack for a workflow
